sourceDocument: Frontier Pilot — Jobs & Career System Design Notes
sourceSection: 20. Namibia Starting Customer Network — Research Shortlist V1
sourceNotes: The source calls this a research shortlist, not a scenery-verified activation list.
Approximate flight times assume 120 knots direct from Eros and do not indicate safety or aircraft suitability.

Section 20 contains no numeric coordinates. Published OurAirports coordinates are added only for the three manually inspected airports and retain explicit source metadata; they are not simulator-derived validation coordinates.

Eros/FYWE, Uis/FYUS and Arandis/FYAR were manually inspected in MSFS 2024 on 2026-09-09. This verifies their simulator identifiers and scenery presence independently from the published coordinate source.
Bulk ore and routine high-volume mining supplies should normally move by road or rail; aviation carries people, samples, high-value freight and urgent or specialist requirements.
Shortlisted communities are not wholly dependent on aircraft; their jobs represent valuable or time-sensitive air transport alongside existing roads.
